exact_source_references.source_document_title: DHA Telehealth Clinical Guidelines for Virtual Management of Asthma – 38

exact_section.heading: 7. Red Flags
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports sudden or severe breathing difficulty, cardiac or chest symptoms, cyanosis, inability to speak full sentences, confusion or agitation, stridor or audible wheeze, immobility or trauma, orthopnoea, status asthmaticus, and near-fatal asthma history as clinician-assessed prompts.

exact_source_references.source_document_title: DHA Telehealth Clinical Guidelines for Virtual Management of Asthma – 38

exact_section.heading: 11.8 Uncontrolled asthma and 12. Referral criteria
